title: EnvironmentPicker
responsibility: Selects the environment scope for changes and switches the shared header summary to that environment.

inputs.name: EnvironmentPicker.workspace
inputs.description: Current project, revision, bridge capabilities and shared deployment stores shown by the app.

inputs.name: EnvironmentPicker.children
inputs.description: Optional action rendered beside the environment choice, such as production promotion. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

outputs.name: EnvironmentPicker
outputs.description: Selects the environment scope for changes and switches the shared header summary to that environment.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: Errors from supplied children callbacks or snippets propagate when invoked; this component does not provide an error boundary.
